title: Marked for Review
story: Noor wants the original routing sentence selected exactly before she sends a correction to the next floor, while Pace insists the copy is equivalent. The player selects with Shift before Caps, tests the Caps exceptions, and reviews every earlier Records gesture in distinct steps. The seal opens the sliding file wall to Mira's chute.

steps.objective: Walk through the review chamber door to the review terminal.
Select the next word, holding Shift before Caps.
Jump to the line end without selecting.
Type A, S and F as plain letters while Caps is held.
Type a short note that mixes literal letters and a word jump.
Walk the four directions with Right Command.
Use Right Command arrows inside an edit.
Select the original routing sentence exactly and replace Pace's copy.
Watch the shelves slide apart and the folder labels regain their colour.
Inspect Noor's annotation on the chamber floor stand.

then.text: Records seal earned: selection, plain-key return and the Caps exceptions all checked in a changed report.

state_changes.before: The circular desk's folders are dull linen, the ring pool is dark and the sliding file wall closes the south of the review chamber.
state_changes.after: The desk folders are coral, sea blue and linen again, the ring pool is lit, the file wall has slid open to a corridor to Mira's chute and the chute light is steady.

visible_changes.note: Fully upright, back at the hub.
The chute light steadies and a slip stands in the slot.
